abrams.name: Siphon Life
abrams.desc:
Drains the life of every nearby enemy, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] each second for the duration.

Abrams recovers [[health|health]] equal to a portion of the damage dealt, with **reduced healing against non-heroes**.
upgrades: +2m Radius, +18 DPS with improved Spirit scaling

abrams.name: Shoulder Charge
abrams.desc:
Abrams charges forward, **pulling along any enemies he hits** and moving faster once he collides with a hero.

Driving a hero into a wall **stuns** them, and heroes hit take [[spirit|spirit damage]].
upgrades: -18s Cooldown, On Hero Collide: +1.5 Weapon Damage for 6s

abrams.name: Infernal Resilience
abrams.desc:
A passive that grants Abrams bonus defensive attributes.

Whenever he takes damage, he gains **temporary regeneration** equal to a portion of the damage taken, spread over the regeneration time.

abrams.name: Seismic Impact
abrams.desc:
Abrams leaps high into the air and slams down, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] to enemies in the impact area and **stunning** them.

The impact reaches units up to 6m above the ground, and the leap can cover up to 55m at full charge.

A devastating engage tool that can lock down an entire team on landing.
upgrades: On cast, become Unstoppable for 5s, +6m Impact Radius

drifter.name: Rend
drifter.desc:
Drifter swipes in a cone ahead of him, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]].

Targets within **close range (8m)** also take bonus melee damage.
upgrades: Deals 55% Heavy Melee Damage, Silences enemies for 2s if close range

drifter.name: Stalker's Mark
drifter.desc:
Drifter fires a mark that **bleeds the first target it hits** for [[spirit|spirit damage]] over time.

Reactivating the ability while the target is bleeding **teleports Drifter behind them**.

drifter.name: Bloodscent
drifter.desc:
Isolated enemy heroes leave a trail and their heartbeat can be heard from afar.

Drifter deals **amplified damage** to isolated heroes and permanently gains [[weapon|bullet damage]] each time one dies nearby.
upgrades: +3m/s Move Speed when around an isolated enemy hero
On isolated hero death: Heal 24% of your missing health, restore 2 Stamina

drifter.name: Eternal Night
drifter.desc:
Drifter shrouds nearby enemy heroes in darkness, **sharply limiting their vision** and briefly revealing them.

Enemies caught in the night count as **isolated**, which powers up Bloodscent.

While it lasts, Drifter gains bonus sprint speed to hunt his prey down. Up to 2 targets can be affected.

kelvin.name: Frost Grenade
kelvin.desc:
Kelvin throws a grenade that bursts into a freezing cloud, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **slowing enemies**.

Allies caught in the cloud are healed instead.
upgrades: -10s Cooldown, debuff now freezes Stamina Regen
+2m Radius, Damage and Heal Spirit Scaling increased

kelvin.name: Ice Path
kelvin.desc:
Kelvin lays down a floating trail of ice and snow that **speeds up him and his allies**.

Kelvin gains **60% slow resistance** while on it, though enemies can walk on the trail too.
upgrades: +2m Move Speed, +35% Bullet Resist for Kelvin while on Ice Path
+35% Spirit, +20 Spirit for Kelvin while on Ice Path

kelvin.name: Arctic Beam
kelvin.desc:
Kelvin fires a freezing beam that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **progressively slows** move speed and fire rate the longer it is held.

He moves slower while firing, and the beam can claim Souls.
upgrades: -20% to Fire Rate and Move Speed
-13s Cooldown, fires 2 additional Arctic Beams within 10m of the last target hit

kelvin.name: Frozen Shelter
kelvin.desc:
Kelvin targets himself or an allied hero and raises a **dome that blocks enemies**.

Allies inside gain rapid [[health|health]] regeneration while enemies are slowed.

Objectives under the dome become **invulnerable and frozen**.
upgrades: Purges non-ult debuffs for you and your allies, +65 Health Regen, increased Spirit scaling

paradox.name: Pulse Grenade
paradox.desc:
Paradox throws a grenade that pulses once it lands. Each pulse **expands the radius by 1m** and deals [[spirit|spirit damage]].

Enemies are time-slowed and gain **stacking damage amplification** against them.

paradox.name: Time Wall
paradox.desc:
Paradox creates a wall that **stops enemy projectiles and bullets** touching it, while boosting the speed and damage of friendly bullets passing through.

Enemies that touch the wall are briefly slowed.

paradox.name: Kinetic Carbine
paradox.desc:
Paradox charges a powerful time-energy shot that deals damage and **Time-Stops** enemies it hits. The shot scales with [[weapon|weapon damage]].

She moves faster while charging, and using alt-fire while airborne and charging **time-slows** her movement.

paradox.name: Paradoxical Swap
paradox.desc:
Paradox fires a projectile that **swaps her position** with the target enemy hero, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] on impact.

The swap lasts about 1.25 seconds.

A great tool for dragging a target into your team or escaping a bad fight.
upgrades: 200 Barrier for 8s, Barrier scales with Spirit
Swaps all enemies within 7m of hit target, +10% Max Health Damage

victor.name: Pain Battery
victor.desc:
Victor charges this ability passively by taking damage. Once full, activating it fires **shocking bolts** that deal [[spirit|spirit damage]] once per target.

Each charge requires damage equal to 40% of his max health.
upgrades: On Hero Hit: Heal for 15% of your missing health, increased Spirit scaling

victor.name: Jumpstart
victor.desc:
Victor deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] to himself, then gains **bonus health regeneration** and [[speed|move speed]] that decay over time.

The self-damage is 15% of his current health.
upgrades: +1 Charge, +50% Debuff Resistance, increased Spirit scaling

victor.name: Aura of Suffering
victor.desc:
Victor emits an aura dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] over time to nearby enemies **and to himself**.

The damage ramps up the longer the aura is channeled, up to a maximum.
upgrades: Enemies receive 20% Move and Dash Slow

victor.name: Shocking Reanimation
victor.desc:
After taking lethal damage, Victor releases a **slowing wave** around him.

He then channels briefly and **revives**, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] and stunning nearby enemies.

He returns with 50% of his [[health|health]], and enemies hit are slowed for 3 seconds after the stun.
upgrades: While On Cooldown: Gain +15% Fire Rate and 6 Spirit Damage per Bullet

apollo.name: Disengaging Sigil
apollo.desc:
Apollo conjures a sigil sphere in front of him, then **leaps backward** as it detonates, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] and slowing enemies caught inside.

A good tool for punishing close-range enemies while creating distance.
upgrades: +25% Fire Rate and +25% Bullet Speed for 8s
On player hit: restores 1 stamina and resets Air Jump/Dash limit

apollo.name: Riposte
apollo.desc:
Apollo readies himself to **deflect the next incoming attack**. On a successful deflection he turns briefly invulnerable and dashes to a targeted enemy hero, stunning them and lowering their Melee Resist.

Does not trigger on trooper or neutral damage.
upgrades: 75% Bullet, Spirit, and Melee Lifesteal against the Riposte target for 13s

apollo.name: Flawless Advance
apollo.desc:
Apollo performs a series of lunges in any direction, delivering piercing stabs. **Holding the ability times the attack**: the longer the hold, the more [[spirit|spirit damage]], with a **perfect release window** dealing the most.

Press the ability again to recast, for up to 3 lunges.
upgrades: +65 Perfect Damage with improved Spirit scaling, increased lunge speed and distance

apollo.name: Itani Lo Sahn
apollo.desc:
Apollo charges and unleashes a **long-range slash**. Struck enemies **cannot take action or heal** and are slowed in time; when the effect ends they take heavy [[spirit|spirit damage]], with bonus damage against enemies at or below half health.

Apollo is **invulnerable** during the slow and enemies take reduced damage meanwhile. Holding the ability or Fire delays the cast.

dynamo.name: Kinetic Pulse
dynamo.desc:
Dynamo sends a pulse of energy along the ground that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **knocks enemies into the air**.

Charges recharge on their own short timer.
upgrades: On hit: -15% Bullet Resist and -24% Move Speed for 4s

dynamo.name: Quantum Entanglement
dynamo.desc:
Dynamo **teleports to the target location**, becoming untargetable for a short time and restoring stamina. An alternate cast brings nearby allies along with him.

Useful both as an escape and as a way to reposition a team.
upgrades: Reduces non-ult debuffs by 50% and replenishes 1 charge

dynamo.name: Rejuvenating Aurora
dynamo.desc:
While channeling, Dynamo **heals himself and nearby allies over time**. Dashing and melee attacks do not interrupt the channel.

The heal scales with [[spirit|Spirit Power]].
upgrades: Aura gives +4m Move Speed during channel
Allows full movement and ability use, and heals an additional 2.5% of Max Health per second

dynamo.name: Singularity
dynamo.desc:
Dynamo forms a singularity in his hands that **pulls in nearby enemies**, stuns them, and deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] every second.

The channel locks enemies in place while the damage accumulates. Higher tiers add damage based on enemy max health.

lady-geist.name: Essence Bomb
lady-geist.desc:
Geist **sacrifices some of her own health** to launch a bomb that detonates after a brief arming time, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] to enemies nearby.

The self-damage is non-lethal and based on the bomb's damage.
upgrades: Bombs leave a toxic mess dealing 30% of the original damage per second for 6s

lady-geist.name: Life Drain
lady-geist.desc:
Geist creates a **tether that drains enemy health** over time and [[health|heals her]]. She can still shoot and use other abilities while it is maintained, and the target is slowed while being damaged.

An alternate cast gives health to friendly heroes at the cost of her own.
upgrades: Enables and grants +2 Charges, increased Spirit scaling

lady-geist.name: Malice
lady-geist.desc:
Geist **sacrifices some of her current health** to launch blood shards that each apply a stack of Malice to enemies they hit.

Each stack increases the damage the target takes and slows them, up to 5 stacks.

lady-geist.name: Soul Exchange
lady-geist.desc:
Geist **swaps health levels with an enemy target**. The target loses a portion of their current health, and if their remaining health is higher than hers the two health percentages are swapped; otherwise she receives the health they lost.

Both the enemy's minimum health and the minimum health she receives are 30%. The swap deals pure damage rather than spirit damage.
upgrades: On cast: +60 Spirit Power, +40% Fire Rate and +50% Spirit Resistance for 8s

pocket.name: Barrage
pocket.desc:
Pocket channels to launch a volley of [[spirit|spirit damage]] projectiles that **slow enemies** around the impact point. Hero hits grant a **stacking damage amp**.

Casting while airborne makes Pocket float, and Air Dash and Flying Cloak do not cancel the channel.

pocket.name: Flying Cloak
pocket.desc:
Pocket launches a sentient cloak that **travels forward**, damaging enemies in its path. Press the ability again to **teleport to the cloak**.

The cloak is a flexible tool for both engaging and escaping.

pocket.name: Enchanter's Satchel
pocket.desc:
Pocket **hides inside the suitcase**; when it ends, nearby enemies take [[spirit|spirit damage]]. Taking any action ends it early.

Works as both an escape and a burst of area damage.
upgrades: +1.5s Duration, +4m Radius, and -32% Move Speed and Fire Rate for 4s

pocket.name: Affliction
pocket.desc:
Pocket afflicts nearby enemies with [[spirit|spirit damage]] **over time**. The damage is non-lethal and does not trigger item procs.

On its highest upgrade it also stops all healing on afflicted enemies.
upgrades: Prevents all healing, +13 DPS with increased Spirit scaling

vindicta.name: Stake
vindicta.desc:
Vindicta throws a stake that **tethers enemies to the spot where it lands**, limiting their movement to the tether length, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] and slowing them.

The tether length is not affected by ability range boosts.

vindicta.name: Flight
vindicta.desc:
Vindicta **leaps into the air and flies**. While airborne her weapon deals bonus [[spirit|spirit damage]] and her items have **increased range**.

A strong repositioning and sniping tool.
upgrades: Hero kills refresh duration, +10 Spirit Damage with increased Spirit scaling

vindicta.name: Crow Familiar
vindicta.desc:
A crow strikes a target, dealing impact [[spirit|spirit damage]], **reducing their bullet and spirit resist**, and applying a bleed based on their current health.

The debuff lasts several seconds.

vindicta.name: Assassinate
vindicta.desc:
Vindicta fires a **long-range hitscan shot** from her scoped rifle. It deals partial damage until fully charged after 1s of scope time, with **bonus damage against targets below 50% health**.

Each kill adds permanent [[weapon|weapon damage]]. Headshots deal extra damage, and a second charge allows a follow-up shot.

baba.name: Threadsap
baba.desc:
Weave a thread that follows your crosshair, then bursts along its path to deal [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **steal enemy Spirit**, which works better for Baba than for anyone else.

While you hold stolen Spirit, every bullet you fire deals bonus [[spirit|spirit damage]].

baba.name: Granny Long Legs
baba.desc:
The bench sprouts legs, granting bonus [[speed|move speed]], higher jumps, **Debuff Resistance and Melee Resistance**.

Light melee becomes a kick that knocks enemies back. Heavy melee is a ground pound that knocks up and slows enemies while dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]]. Hold Crouch/Slide to charge a high jump.
upgrades: +15% Resists, +50% Melee Lifesteal, Healing triggers Healing Tempo's unique effect

baba.name: Baba's Brew
baba.desc:
Hurl a pot of tea that creates an area effect cycling between a soothing **barrier**, a **Silence**, and a scalding burn that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] over time and lowers spirit resist.

Zoom/alt-fire pauses or resumes the brewing.

baba.name: Feed The Birds
baba.desc:
Cover enemies in front of you with bread, applying a **stacking slow** for as long as you channel.

When the channel ends, a flock of pigeons bombards the target for [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **hexes it into a pigeon**.

Damage and hex duration grow with the amount of bread stacked, reaching their maximum after 3.5 seconds.
upgrades: +125 Max Damage, +1.5 Spirit Scaling, +0.5s Max Duration

graves.name: Jar of Dead
graves.desc:
Passively collects "death" from fallen units nearby. Activate it to throw a jar that summons **Deadheads**, which repeatedly strike enemies for [[spirit|spirit damage]].

Deadheads follow you when no enemies are around and prioritize your weapon's target.
upgrades: Collecting death heals 5 health per pickup

graves.name: Grasping Hands
graves.desc:
Unearth a line of grasping hands that raises a **Ghoul** and leaves behind a rift.

Enemies crossing the rift take [[spirit|spirit damage]] and are **immobilized**. Alt-cast rotates the wall's orientation.

graves.name: Essence Theft
graves.desc:
Your weapon gradually **steals enemies' weapon damage and spirit resist** over time, up to a maximum on each target.

The theft builds up to its full value over 4 seconds and can affect several targets at once.
upgrades: +1 Max Steal Targets, All Summons now apply Essence Theft

graves.name: Borrowed Decree
graves.desc:
Raise a gravestone at the target location that **summons Ghouls over time**. Enemies can destroy it with two heavy melee attacks.

Your abilities can also send Ghouls marching toward the enemy base, where they deal melee damage and explode near heroes or objectives, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] and briefly slowing.
upgrades: On Death: Deal +5% Current Health as Damage

lash.name: Ground Strike
lash.desc:
Stomp the ground beneath you to damage enemies in front of you. Cast while airborne and you **dive toward the ground**, dealing more [[spirit|spirit damage]] the farther you fall.

Damage growth per meter slows after 25m.
upgrades: Struck enemies are knocked up and slowed by 40% for 3s
Damage Per Meter +120% and improved scaling

lash.name: Grapple
lash.desc: Pull yourself through the air toward a target. Using Grapple also **resets your air jumps and dashes**.
upgrades: +1 Charge, On Cast: +1 Stamina and +60% Air Control

lash.name: Flog
lash.desc: Lash enemies in front of you with your whip, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **healing** for a portion of the damage dealt.

lash.name: Death Slam
lash.desc:
Focus on enemies to connect your whips to them. After the channel, connected enemies are **lifted and thrown** before being slammed into the ground.

The impact deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] in a landing zone and slows survivors.
upgrades: Stun enemies in Radius for 1.2s, +6m Cast Range

rem.name: Pillow Toss
rem.desc:
Throw a pillow that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **heavy knockback**, leaving a fading [[speed|move speed]] slow.

Landing a hit reduces the cooldown of your other abilities.

rem.name: Tag Along
rem.desc:
Jump to an ally and nap alongside them. You both receive a burst [[health|heal]] based on missing health, followed by lingering regeneration.

Hop between allies with Ability 2 to apply the heal once per ally. A stun from an ultimate knocks you off. Items and self-casts target your ally instead.
upgrades: 35% Bonus Item Range, Duration, and Barrier Effectiveness while napping
+15% Spirit Power and +35 Spirit Power while napping and for 10s after, improved Spirit Scaling

rem.name: Lil Helpers
rem.desc:
Signal a Helper to assist. Helpers can collect boxes, perform Sinner's Sacrifices, or **support allies and troopers**.

Following a hero grants spirit resist and fading [[speed|move speed]]; following a trooper grants healing, damage, resists, and tag-along ability. Can be cast during Tag Along. Helpers nap for 15.1s after following.

rem.name: Naptime
rem.desc:
Cast a gaze forward that **pierces walls and floors**. Enemies caught in it are slowed, have reduced dash distance, and cannot use movement abilities.

When the channel ends they fall asleep, then wake with a headache that deals heavy [[spirit|spirit damage]].

You take reduced damage while channeling.
upgrades: -1 Stamina on wake, no Stamina Regen while sleeping
-55s Cooldown, reduced damage and unstoppable while channeling

viscous.name: Splatter
viscous.desc:
Throw a goo ball that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] and leaves **puddles that slow** enemies in the radius.

The ball bounces, but repeat hits on the same target deal less damage each time.

viscous.name: The Cube
viscous.desc:
Encase a target, Viscous included, in restorative goo that **blocks damage** and boosts [[health|health regen]].

The target cannot take new actions while cubed, but can jump or mantle to escape early.
upgrades: Increases Move Speed and Stamina Recovery

viscous.name: Puddle Punch
viscous.desc:
Summon a fist that punches everyone in the area, **knocking them up**. Punched enemies take melee damage and are slowed.

Enemies can parry it.
upgrades: -14s Cooldown, now deals Heavy Melee Damage

viscous.name: Goo Ball
viscous.desc:
Turn into a large ball that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **stuns enemies** on impact.

The ball grants large bullet and spirit resist, bounces off walls, and allows double jumps.

bebop.name: Exploding Uppercut
bebop.desc: Bebop punches nearby targets into the air with a **knockback**, and it can also be used on allies. When they land, enemies take [[spirit|spirit damage]] and nearby foes suffer a **reduced fire rate**.
upgrades: On Hero Hit: Gain fast spin-up time, 2x weapon range and +30% weapon damage for 9s
On Hero Hit: Set Grapple Arm cooldown to 0 and restore 18% of your missing health

bebop.name: Sticky Bomb
bebop.desc: Sticks a **delayed bomb** onto a target that blows up after a short fuse, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] to enemies nearby. Hitting or killing heroes with it grants **permanent bonus damage**, which is halved after 60 hits and 7 kills.
upgrades: On Cast: +5m Move Speed and +25% Debuff Resistance for 6s

bebop.name: Grapple Arm
bebop.desc: Fires a mechanical hand that **pulls the first character it hits** toward Bebop, allies included. The target takes melee damage and is left with a brief heavy slow once the pull ends.

bebop.name: Hyper Beam
bebop.desc:
Bebop channels a long beam that burns enemies for [[spirit|spirit damage]] every 0.1s and applies a **move speed slow**. It takes about 1s to power up, deals half damage to objectives, and is weaker within roughly 9m of the arm.

The beam covers a 5m area near the arm, 2.9m along its length and 4m at the end.
upgrades: Hyper Beam heals Bebop for 65% of its damage on heroes, 20% on non-heroes

grey-talon.name: Charged Shot
grey-talon.desc: Hold to charge a **piercing shot** that can be held indefinitely. Walking speed drops to 1.5 m/s while charging, and cancelling the charge still consumes a charge.
upgrades: Improved damage scaling and -3s Charge Delay

grey-talon.name: Rain of Arrows
grey-talon.desc: Launches Talon into the air to **glide**, granting bonus [[weapon|bullet damage]] and **multishot**. An alternate cast gives a lower jump, and jumping or mantling cancels the glide while touching the ground ends it.
upgrades: While airborne, +3 Weapon Damage and weapon damage applies 24% movement slow for 1.5s
While airborne, +30% Bullet Lifesteal, +30% Spirit Lifesteal and +30% Bullet Evasion

grey-talon.name: Spirit Snare
grey-talon.desc: Places a trap that arms after 2s and springs when an enemy walks in. Victims are **cursed** and slowed: interrupted, silenced, disarmed, and unable to use items. A Charged Shot detonates it early with a **30% larger radius**.

grey-talon.name: Guided Owl
grey-talon.desc:
After a short cast, Talon sends out a **controllable spirit owl**. Holding forward accelerates it, and it explodes on impact to deal [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **stun** enemies. Jumping releases control of the owl.

Every enemy hero killed with the owl grants Talon **permanent Spirit Power**.
upgrades: After hit, kills enemies that are below 22% Health

mcginnis.name: Mini Turret
mcginnis.desc: Deploys a turret that fires at enemies, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] over time until it expires. It targets the nearest visible hero first, and deals reduced damage to troopers and objectives.
upgrades: +25% Turret Fire Rate and +12s Turret Lifetime

mcginnis.name: Medicinal Specter
mcginnis.desc: Summons a spirit that **heals allies** standing near it. Healing from overlapping Specters does not stack, and buffs linger for 1s after leaving the area.
upgrades: +2% Max HP Regen, +3m Heal Radius, +40% Spirit Resist

mcginnis.name: Spectral Wall
mcginnis.desc:
Sends out a wall that **slows enemies** it passes through, then erupts to split the terrain and deal [[spirit|spirit damage]]. Press Fire or Ability 3 to erupt it early.

Each wall segment has 200 health and can be destroyed by anyone.
upgrades: Amplifies McGinnis's damage by +20% on hit enemies for 7s
Deploy 2 Mini Turrets near the wall for 8s, +24% Slow

mcginnis.name: Heavy Barrage
mcginnis.desc:
Unleashes a volley of **homing rockets** at a targeted location, six per second. McGinnis is slowed while firing but can still use stamina.

Each rocket explodes for [[spirit|spirit damage]] and deals half damage to objectives. A minimum range of 8.5m applies.
upgrades: Applies 24% movement and dash slow for 1s
+2m Radius and +15 Damage per Rocket with increased spirit scaling

seven.name: Lightning Ball
seven.desc: Fires a ball of lightning in a straight line that hits everything in its radius for [[spirit|spirit damage]]. It **slows down** while damaging enemies and stops when it hits the world.
upgrades: -28% move speed on hit targets and +1s Lifetime

seven.name: Static Charge
seven.desc: Places a charge on an enemy hero. After a short delay it discharges, **stunning** and dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] to enemies in the radius.

seven.name: Power Surge
seven.desc: Charges up your weapon so your shots proc **shock damage** that bounces to nearby enemies, once per burst. Ricochet bullets do not receive Power Surge.
upgrades: +3m Move Speed and +8 Damage and increased scaling

seven.name: Storm Cloud
seven.desc:
Seven channels an **expanding storm cloud** around himself that damages all enemies inside it who are in line of sight. It starts at 10m and grows to 30m, dealing half damage to objectives.

While channeling, pressing Fire marks an area for a **lightning strike** that knocks enemies away after a short delay, usable once per cast.
upgrades: +55% Bullet Resist while channeling Storm Cloud
+7s Channel Time, +10m Final Radius and +5m Initial Radius

vyper.name: Screwjab Dagger
vyper.desc: Throws a dagger that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **slows** the target. Further daggers on the same target **stack** both damage and slow, up to 3 stacks.
upgrades: On Hit: -8% Bullet Resist and -6% Bullet Resist per Stack
+2 Max Stacks, -2s Charge Delay, On Hit: Refund 55% Charge Cooldown

vyper.name: Lethal Venom
vyper.desc: Injects a target with venom that, after a delay, deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] which **grows with the target's missing health**. It ignores Petrify's damage block. Valid targets include players, neutral camps and structures.
upgrades: Bullets also build up Lethal Venom

vyper.name: Slither
vyper.desc: A passive that improves Vyper's slide: it travels **15% farther**, climbs hills, and turns faster while sliding. Slopes cost no speed.

vyper.name: Petrifying Bola
vyper.desc:
Hurls a bola in a straight line that explodes to **slow** and deal [[spirit|spirit damage]] to all enemies in the radius. A direct hit deals extra damage and **petrifies** the target, who then blocks all damage but cannot act.

The projectile disappears after 100m and can damage troopers, creeps and objectives.
upgrades: +1s Petrify Duration. Petrifies all enemies in the area.

billy.name: Bashdown
billy.desc:
Slam your bat into the ground, creating a shockwave that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **knocks enemies up**, pulling them down afterwards. The channel can be held for up to 1s.

Also deals melee damage to enemies caught in the slam.
upgrades: -3s Charge Time, Now deals 50% Heavy Melee Damage

billy.name: Rising Ram
billy.desc:
After a short wind-up, charge head-first into an enemy and **launch them into the air** together with Billy. Deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] on impact, and the cooldown is **reduced by 50% on impact**.

Only targets heroes and Neutrals, not Troopers or objectives.

billy.name: Blasted
billy.desc:
Passive: melee hits restore ammo and apply **Wrecked** to the victim for 7s.

Active: your bullets are amplified against Wrecked enemies, and using melee while active grants **bonus max health** and extends the effect.
upgrades: +1 Bashdown Charge on use, +7% Wrecked Bullet Amp
+50 Melee Bonus Health, increased spirit scaling

billy.name: Chain Gang
billy.desc:
Chain nearby enemies to Billy. Chained enemies **can't use movement abilities** and are heavily slowed when they pull on the chain.

After a delay, everyone is **yanked to within 4m** of Billy and takes [[spirit|spirit damage]]. The chain breaks if line of sight is lost for a short while.

The cast is not interruptible and isn't affected by ability duration modifiers.
upgrades: +5m Range, +1.3s Unstoppable Per Hero pulled in

haze.name: Sleep Dagger
haze.desc:
Throw a dagger that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **puts the target to sleep**. Sleeping targets wake shortly after taking damage.

Throwing it doesn't break invisibility or interrupt enemy channels.
upgrades: -10% Bullet Resist Reduction for 6s on wake-up
-17s Cooldown, -40% Move and Dash Speed for 3s on wake-up

haze.name: Smoke Bomb
haze.desc:
Fade out of sight, becoming **invisible** and gaining sprint speed. Attacking breaks invisibility, but using items does not.

Close enemies can still see through the invisibility.
upgrades: Dispels non-ult debuffs, +50% Bullet Lifesteal for 5s

haze.name: Fixation
haze.desc:
Shooting a target **increases your bullet damage** on that target. Each bullet hit grants one stack and a headshot grants three.

Deals only 20% damage to objectives.
upgrades: 40 Spirit damage and 12% slow for 2s to target every 20 stacks
+0.11 per Stack, Scales with Weapon Damage

haze.name: Bullet Dance
haze.desc:
Enter a flurry, firing your weapon at nearby enemies with **perfect accuracy** and added [[weapon|bullet damage]].

Haze gains bonus fire rate and bullet evasion while channeling, and can still slide and use active items. Not affected by Disarm.

The firing angle is 65 degrees and cannot be increased.

mina.name: Rake
mina.desc:
Slash with your umbrella, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] plus a percentage of the target's **missing health**. Killing a target heals Mina, and non-hero targets below 60 health are executed.

Holding alt-fire makes Mina briefly float, for up to 4s while airborne.
upgrades: +7% Missing Health Damage, increased Spirit scaling on kill heal

mina.name: Sanguine Retreat
mina.desc:
Briefly disperse, becoming **untargetable** while flying to the target location. Can be recast within a 4s window.

Disabled by Slowing Hex, but can be cast while channeling Nox Nostra.

mina.name: Love Bites
mina.desc:
Passive: your bullets deal extra [[spirit|spirit damage]], and damaging with abilities builds toward a **bonus Spirit burst**. The cooldown is tracked separately for each target.

Headshots build the burst faster; melee does not proc it.
upgrades: +3 Spirit Damage Per Bullet, +45 Bonus Damage
-5s Cooldown, On proc: +25% fire rate for 5s

mina.name: Nox Nostra
mina.desc:
Release a cloud of homing bats. Each bat deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] and applies **Silence** to the hero it hits.

Each Love Bite on a hero adds 2 bats, up to 75 released in total. Bat release pauses during teleports, but Mina can still cast Sanguine Retreat while channeling.

Deals 50% damage to objectives.
upgrades: On hit: +0.5% current health as damage

shiv.name: Serrated Knives
shiv.desc:
Throw a knife that **bleeds** an enemy. Each extra hit adds a stack and refreshes the bleed, with its strength rising per stack.

Knives can confirm soul orbs, consuming a charge. With full Rage, knives also deal current-health damage and **slow** bled enemies.

rows.l: Current Health Impact At Full Rage

shiv.name: Slice and Dice
shiv.desc:
Dash forward, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] to enemies along the path and **reducing their spirit resist**. The debuff stacks, and each stack lasts 14s.

At full Rage, an echo of Shiv retraces the dash after a short delay and damages enemies again.
upgrades: +50 Impact Damage, -2s Cooldown per hero hit

shiv.name: Bloodletting
shiv.desc:
Take only part of incoming damage immediately and **defer the rest** over time. Activating it clears part of the deferred damage.

At full Rage, more incoming damage is deferred. Affected by healing modifiers, including anti-heal.

shiv.name: Killing Blow
shiv.desc:
Leap forward, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] to the first enemy hero hit. If that hero is below the health threshold, Shiv **executes them** instead.

Shiv travels until max range or until he hits a sub-threshold enemy, damaging players, Troopers and Denizens along the way. Damaging enemies builds Rage, and a kill opens a 16s recast window.

Cooldown is 30% longer if no hero is hit.
upgrades: +6m Range, +2 m/s Move Speed in full Rage

warden.name: Alchemical Flask
warden.desc: Throw a flask that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] and reduces the **weapon damage** and [[speed|move speed]] of enemies it hits.

warden.name: Willpower
warden.desc: Gain a **Barrier** and bonus [[speed|move speed]] for a short time.

warden.name: Binding Word
warden.desc: Curse an enemy hero. If they don't move away from their initial position within the escape time, they take [[spirit|spirit damage]] and are **immobilized**.
upgrades: Warden deals +20% more Bullet Damage to trapped Heroes for 5s
-14s Cooldown, Silences enemies until they escape or are immobilized

warden.name: Last Stand
warden.desc:
After charging for 2s, release pulses every 0.5s that deal [[spirit|spirit damage]] to nearby enemies and **heal you** based on the damage done.

While charging, Warden gains 50% bullet and spirit resist. Deals 50% damage to objectives.
upgrades: +4s Duration, Unstoppable and +30% Resists while channeling

calico.name: Gloom Bombs
calico.desc:
Hurl a cluster of bombs that detonate after a short delay, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] to enemies caught in the blast.

An enemy struck by several bombs takes only **65% damage** from each additional one.
upgrades: Per Bomb Touch: -6% Melee Resist for 6s

calico.name: Leaping Slash
calico.desc:
Dash forward and slash every enemy in a circle for melee damage. The dash ends on colliding with the first enemy hero hit.

If the slash hits at least one hero, you **heal a small amount**.
upgrades: +60 Damage, On Hero Hit: 50% Cooldown Refund

calico.name: Ava
calico.desc:
Shadow-transform into Calico's cat, Ava, gaining [[speed|move speed]] that **grows over time** while hidden from the minimap.

Taking damage from an enemy hero resets the bonus and puts Ava on a brief cooldown.
upgrades: Gains Damage Amp over time, up to 18%, lingering for 6s

calico.name: Return to Shadows
calico.desc:
Instantly melt into shadow, becoming **untargetable** with bonus [[speed|move speed]] and bonus [[spirit|spirit damage]].

After a 3s delay Calico bursts out of the shadows, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] to nearby enemies.

The Tier 3 cooldown refund does not apply to Return to Shadows itself.
upgrades: On Completion: Heal for 450 and refund all ability cooldowns

holliday.name: Powder Keg
holliday.desc:
Throw a barrel that explodes after a short delay, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]], **setting enemies on fire** and launching them upward.

Each charge regenerates on a 7.5s timer.
upgrades: +40 Impact Damage, +13.3 Burn Damage Per Second, -5s Charge Time, Improved Spirit Scaling

holliday.name: Bounce Pad
holliday.desc:
Drop a bounce pad that **launches any hero** who steps on it. Landing causes a stomp that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] to nearby enemies.

Launched heroes keep full air control.
upgrades: You and allies gain a +4m/s move speed bonus for 4s on landing

holliday.name: Crackshot
holliday.desc:
While off cooldown, [[weapon|headshots]] deal **bonus damage** and apply a fading [[speed|move speed]] slow. It ignores range fall-off and does not affect objectives.

Cooldown is reduced by 50% when hitting NPCs.
upgrades: -6s Cooldown on Hero Headshots, -3s on NPC Headshots

holliday.name: Spirit Lasso
holliday.desc:
Fling out a lasso that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]], **pulls** the target to you and **stuns** them.

Using a Bounce Pad extends the lasso's duration.

mirage.name: Fire Scarabs
mirage.desc:
Infest an enemy with fire scarabs that **steal [[health|health]]** over time and cause them to deal reduced damage.

Reapplying to the same enemy only refreshes the duration.

mirage.name: Dust Devil
mirage.desc:
Turn into a whirlwind that surges forward, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]], slowing enemies and **lifting them into the air**. Mirage is invincible while casting.

Afterwards, Mirage gains a chance to evade bullets.

mirage.name: Djinn's Mark
mirage.desc:
Passively, your shots apply a **Djinn Mark** to the target; each added mark doubles the damage stored.

Activate to consume all marks on enemies and deal their [[spirit|spirit damage]] immediately. Marks last 5s and reveal the target for 6s.
upgrades: On Proc: Apply a fading 48% Slow for 0.8s
-0.75s Cooldown, +1 Max Marks, Stun Victim for 0.5s on Max Marks

mirage.name: Traveler
mirage.desc:
Pick a location on the minimap and, after a brief wait, **teleport** there. Taking damage interrupts the teleport.

Using Traveler drops the Soul Urn.

An interrupted cast puts the ability on a 4s interrupt cooldown.
upgrades: +3m Move Speed and +20% Fire Rate for 12s

silver.name: Slam Fire
silver.desc:
**Instantly reload** your gun and gain bonus fire rate for a limited number of shots, at reduced accuracy.

Shots also deal bonus [[weapon|weapon damage]] based on the target's current health.
upgrades: If you hit all shots, deal +7% current health as damage

silver.name: Boot Kick
silver.desc:
Dash forward and kick the first enemy hit for melee damage, **marking** them.

Shooting the marked target deals bonus [[spirit|spirit damage]] and consumes the mark.
upgrades: +80 Bonus Damage, kicked enemies deal -35% Damage for 5s

silver.name: Entangling Bola
silver.desc:
Throw a bola that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]], **slows** the target and prevents them from using movement abilities or stamina.

The bola flies until it is interrupted and is not affected by ability range.
upgrades: +0.75s Debuff Duration, Bola ricochets to 2 additional targets (15m)

silver.name: Lycan Curse
silver.desc:
Passively builds **bloodlust** from damage dealt. Activate to instantly transform Silver into a werewolf with increased max [[health|health]] and stacking fire rate on enemy heroes.

Silver's abilities and weapon are replaced by their ferocious versions, and she heals from missing health.

The cooldown does not begin until the transformation ends.
upgrades: +4 m/s Move Speed and 200 Bonus Health
On Hero Kill: Refresh abilities and duration

wraith.name: Card Trick
wraith.desc:
Dealing [[weapon|weapon damage]] summons cards of a random suit that fly toward the enemy or the point under your crosshair. Alt-cast throws the first card.

Suits: **Spade** adds +60% bonus damage, **Diamond** gives -7% bullet and spirit resist, **Club** slows by 24% and **Heart** heals 60. Jokers count as every suit.
upgrades: All suits are improved and higher chance for Jokers

wraith.name: Project Mind
wraith.desc:
Teleport to the targeted location after a short, interruptible channel.

Slowing Hex disables it.
upgrades: 300 Barrier for 5s, scales with Spirit Power

wraith.name: Full Auto
wraith.desc:
Temporarily boost your **fire rate** and add bonus [[spirit|spirit damage]] to each bullet.

Plated Armor prevents the on-shot effect.
upgrades: Unlimited Ammo and Increased Scaling on Spirit Damage Per Bullet

wraith.name: Telekinesis
wraith.desc:
Lift an enemy hero into the air, stunning them during the channel, then **slam** them toward a target location for [[spirit|spirit damage]].

The slam slows the victim and prevents stamina and movement-based items and abilities.

The target can be thrown up to 13m away.
upgrades: +1.5s Debuff Duration and +6m Throw and Cast Range

celeste.name: Light Eater
celeste.desc:
Blast enemies in a cone with a flare of light. Flared enemies take bonus [[spirit|spirit damage]] whenever Celeste hits them with her gun.

While enemies are flared, Celeste also gains **spirit lifesteal** from attacking them.

celeste.name: Dazzling Trick
celeste.desc: Wrap yourself in a protective prism that **blocks incoming damage**. If the barrier is broken, it bursts and **silences nearby enemies** while dealing a portion of the barrier's strength as [[spirit|spirit damage]].
upgrades: +1.25s Silence Duration, -20s Cooldown, Allows Shining Wonder Bounce

celeste.name: Radiant Daggers
celeste.desc:
Call down a beam of light from the sky. After a short delay it explodes, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] to everything in the area, reaching **all vertical layers**.

Every time it hits an enemy hero, Celeste gains a **stacking buff** that increases her spirit damage.
upgrades: +9% Fire Rate Per Stack, +4% Spirit Amp Per Stack

celeste.name: Shining Wonder
celeste.desc:
Launch a deadly orb of light that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]], **slows**, and reduces dash distance on impact. It then bounces between nearby enemies, **prioritizing heroes**.

The orb can be held and released when ready, and lingers briefly if it finds no hero to bounce to.

It bounces off troopers and denizens, but passes through objectives.

infernus.name: Napalm
infernus.desc:
Spray an incendiary mixture that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]], **slows** the target and coats them in napalm.

Napalm-coated enemies take increased damage for the duration.

infernus.name: Flame Dash
infernus.desc:
Dash forward with **slow resistance**, leaving a flaming trail that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] over time. Holding forward extends the dash.

Enemies who leave the trail keep burning for 1 more second. Deals half damage to objectives.

infernus.name: Afterburn
infernus.desc:
Weapon hits build up a burn that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] over time. Headshots and melee hits build it faster.

Using abilities **refreshes the burn**, and further weapon hits extend its duration.

infernus.name: Concussive Combustion
infernus.desc:
Turn yourself into a delayed explosion that deals heavy [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **stuns** nearby enemies. Once activated, it **cannot be interrupted**.

A burning ring marks the radius during the delay, and both allies and enemies can see it without needing line of sight.

Shadow Weave hides the ring from enemies, but stepping too close or taking damage reveals it.

mo-and-krill.name: Scorn
mo-and-krill.desc: Damage nearby enemies with [[spirit|spirit damage]] and heal based on the damage dealt, with **much stronger healing against enemy heroes**.
upgrades: Adds a stacking debuff (16s): Mo & Krill deal +15% damage to affected enemies

mo-and-krill.name: Burrow
mo-and-krill.desc:
Burrow underground, gaining [[speed|move speed]], spirit armor and bullet armor. Damage from enemy heroes reduces the speed bonus.

Jumping out deals [[spirit|spirit damage]], **slows** and knocks enemies up.

mo-and-krill.name: Sand Blast
mo-and-krill.desc: Spray sand in front of Mo & Krill that **disarms** enemies and deals [[spirit|spirit damage]].
upgrades: Slows targets by -24% and reduces dash distance by -26%

mo-and-krill.name: Combo
mo-and-krill.desc:
Hold a target in place, **stunning** them and dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] throughout the channel.

If the target dies during the channel or within 3 seconds after it ends, Mo & Krill **permanently gain max health**.
upgrades: +0.7s Duration, +40 Damage Per Second, Increased Scaling

sinclair.name: Vexing Bolt
sinclair.desc:
Fire a magic bolt that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **grows stronger the longer it travels**, reaching full strength after 2 seconds. An active Assistant also casts a weaker bolt.

Ability 1 redirects the bolt toward your crosshairs.

sinclair.name: Spectral Assistant
sinclair.desc:
Summon an Assistant at the targeted location. It attacks whenever Sinclair fires, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]]. Casting also reloads your weapon.

Ability 2 **swaps positions** with the Assistant while it is active, up to twice.

sinclair.name: Rabbit Hex
sinclair.desc:
Hex an area, turning all enemy heroes inside into **Rabbits**. Rabbits are small and [[speed|move faster]], but take increased damage and cannot perform most actions.

The hex does not interrupt abilities already in progress.

sinclair.name: Audience Participation
sinclair.desc:
Copy the ultimate of an enemy hero for a limited time. Reactivating the ability casts the copied ultimate after a 1 second delay.

The copy **inherits this ability's upgrade points**, and comes off cooldown at 60% of the original's cooldown.

Sinclair can copy an ultimate even if the target hasn't unlocked it. If the copy is never used, the default cooldown applies.

yamato.name: Power Slash
yamato.desc:
Channel to build damage, then release a sword strike. Releasing early deals only partial damage; a fully charged slash fires automatically at 1.4 seconds.

While charging, Yamato has **bullet resist** but is slowed heavily.
upgrades: +8m Cast Range, +150 Damage, Increased Spirit Scaling

yamato.name: Flying Slash
yamato.desc:
Throw a grappling hook to pull Yamato toward an enemy, dealing melee damage and **slowing** the target on arrival.

The connection does not break at distance, and Yamato can pass through walls. Dispels and invincibility break it.
upgrades: Alt-Cast to Grapple allies, +15m Cast Range, +1 Charge

yamato.name: Crimson Slash
yamato.desc: Slash enemies in front of you, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **reducing their fire rate**. Hitting enemy heroes [[health|heals]] Yamato.
upgrades: On Hero Hit: +6% Max Health Heal

yamato.name: Shadow Transformation
yamato.desc:
Infuse Yamato with her brother's shadow soul. After an **invincible** transformation, her abilities refresh and speed up, and she gains **status effect immunity** and greatly increased resists.

Hero kills [[health|heal]] her and extend the duration.

Ability speed shortens Power Slash's full charge, Crimson Slash's cast delay and Flying Slash's travel.

the-doorman.name: Call Bell
the-doorman.desc:
Hurls a bell that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] when it lands, then **explodes after a short delay** for more [[spirit|spirit damage]] and a debuff on nearby enemies. The bell can be **shot or meleed to detonate early**.

Enemies caught in the blast lose weapon accuracy and [[speed|move speed]] for a few seconds.

the-doorman.name: Doorway
the-doorman.desc:
Places **two linked doors**; heroes and most projectiles that enter one door come out of the other. The doors shut when the duration runs out.

The doors cannot be closed for 8s after the second one is placed, and that delay ignores cooldown reduction.
upgrades: Grants a Barrier the first time a player travels through the doors
+30m Cast Range, +40m Doorway Distance, Scales with Spirit Power

the-doorman.name: Luggage Cart
the-doorman.desc:
Sends a cart rolling out that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **drags enemy heroes along its path**. An alternate cast targets friendly heroes instead.

With upgrades, slamming a dragged enemy into a wall deals extra damage and stuns.

the-doorman.name: Hotel Guest
the-doorman.desc:
Sends the targeted hero's body off to the Baroness Hotel as a **guest**. They exit via the elevator and return to their original position when the stay ends.

The stay costs the target [[spirit|spirit damage]], and **failing to check out in time** costs even more.

While the Baroness is occupied, the target is kept away from the fight for the full duration.
upgrades: +150 Damage, 1.5s Stun on Failure to Check Out
Unstoppable While the Baroness Is Occupied, 15s Cooldown on Failure to Check Out

ivy.name: Entangling Thorns
ivy.desc:
Summons a patch of thorns that deals [[spirit|spirit damage]] every second and **slows enemies** standing inside it.

Stack it with a second charge to keep an area locked down.
upgrades: Enemies caught for 2s are Immobilized for +1.6s

ivy.name: Kudzu Connection
ivy.desc:
Tethers Ivy to a nearby ally (line of sight required), sharing **fire rate and lifesteal bonuses** and replicating healing between them. Ivy gets **50% of the bonuses** even without a connection.

The move speed penalty is ignored while shooting.

ivy.name: Stone Form
ivy.desc:
Turns Ivy into **impervious stone**, then smashes the ground to deal [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **stun nearby enemies** while healing her.

The heal is based on a portion of her max [[health|health]].
upgrades: +0.75s Stun Duration, Improved Damage Spirit Scaling

ivy.name: Air Drop
ivy.desc:
Grabs an ally, **flies with them**, then drops them to cause an explosion. When the flight ends, Ivy and the ally gain bonus outgoing damage.

Using it on an allied hero cuts the cooldown by 30%. Taking damage briefly disables casting, and while lifted the ally **cannot attack** and deals -20% damage.

The explosion hits a huge area around the landing point.
upgrades: On Flight End: 300 Barrier to Ivy and Ally, Scales with Spirit
3s Silence on Enemies Hit, Increased Damage and Barrier Scaling

paige.name: Bookwyrm
paige.desc:
Summons a dragon that **flies forward**, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] on the initial hit and leaving a **burning trail** behind it.

Enemies standing in the trail take [[spirit|spirit damage]] every second.

paige.name: Plot Armor
paige.desc:
Grants an ally a **barrier**. While it holds, they gain bonus [[weapon|weapon damage]].

The barrier and damage bonus both grow with spirit power.
upgrades: Affects up to 2 Additional Allies, Increased Barrier Scaling

paige.name: Captivating Read
paige.desc:
Targets an area and **slows enemies** inside it, then detonates after a short delay to deal [[spirit|spirit damage]] and **immobilize** them.

The detonation lands 1.25s after the cast.
upgrades: +2m Radius, On Hit: -18% Spirit Resist for 6s

paige.name: Rallying Charge
paige.desc:
Releases **spectral knights and steeds** that charge across the city, healing allies and damaging enemies they hit. Their effects **grow with travel distance**, peaking at 100% amplification after 250m.

Enemies take [[spirit|spirit damage]] and are stunned, while allies are healed and gain bonus [[speed|move speed]].

The cooldown is halved if the charge hits no allies or enemies.

venator.name: Consecrating Grenade
venator.desc:
Fires a **bouncing grenade** that deals [[weapon|bullet damage]] and sets enemies on fire. Burning targets take pure damage over time and have their healing reduced.

The burn lasts 3.5s.
upgrades: -20% Incoming Healing, Allows Charges (affected by charge items such as Rapid Recharge)

venator.name: Gutshot
venator.desc:
Fires a **shotgun blast** that deals [[weapon|bullet damage]] and knocks enemies back. Enemies knocked near a wall are **stunned** and take bonus [[weapon|bullet damage]].

The wall check reaches 7m from the target.
upgrades: On Wall Stun: next heavy melee is blessed (115 bonus pure damage, executes enemies below 8% health, lasts 5s)

venator.name: Hex-Lined Snap Trap
venator.desc:
Kicks a trap that arms after a short delay and **springs on the first enemy hero** it touches, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]], immobilizing them and **revealing** enemies.

Enemies can disarm it by shooting it, and it only targets players, not NPCs.

venator.name: Ira Domini
venator.desc:
Loads the crossbow with **3 stakes** that deal heavily increased [[weapon|weapon damage]]. The final stake is **blessed**, dealing bonus pure damage and **executing low-health enemies**.

Bolts are hitscan and pierce enemies, and headshots deal 30% bonus critical damage. Venator cannot throw Consecrating Grenade while it is active, and disarm affects it.

The cooldown starts as soon as the ability is used.

rat-king.name: Scrap Grenade
rat-king.desc:
Throws a grenade that **detonates multiple times**, dealing [[weapon|bullet damage]] and applying a slow to enemies caught in each blast. A melee hit can knock it away.

It bounces toward enemies within range, and a larger final detonation is unlocked by its top upgrade.
upgrades: Adds an Additional Final, Bigger Detonation

rat-king.name: Rat Swarm
rat-king.desc:
Calls a swarm of rats that **leap onto enemies**, dealing [[spirit|spirit damage]] over time and **reducing bullet resist** with each bite. The more rats attached, the faster they bite.

Enemies can shake a rat off early with a ground or air dash.
upgrades: +8 Damage Per Bite, -1% Bullet Resist Per Bite

rat-king.name: Royal Pestments
rat-king.desc:
Grants a **barrier based on max health**. While the armor holds, incoming bullets have a chance to be **deflected back** at the attacker.

The barrier ignores resists and also mitigates pure damage.
upgrades: Reduces All Damage to a Max of 250, +10% Max Health as Barrier

rat-king.name: Rule, Ratannia!
rat-king.desc:
Charges up and plants the **Ratannia banner**. Nearby allies gain [[speed|move speed]], **immunity to slows** and reduced damage taken while the flag stands.

Rat King can then slam the banner, dealing [[weapon|bullet damage]], **knocking up and slowing** enemies in line of sight, and summoning rats that apply Rat Swarm.

The slam slows Rat King himself.
